description: Verification report for data/processed/counts.parquet (not a contract file). Real SCATS counts for the listed day(s), cleaned, QC'd against the same weekday in earlier weeks, mapped to SUMO approach edges.
licence: Derived from DTP Traffic Signal Volume Data and Traffic Signal Configuration Data Sheets (CC BY 4.0), modified; see data/SOURCES.md
attribution: Traffic counts: Contains Department of Transport and Planning (Victoria) Traffic Signal Volume Data, CC BY 4.0, modified
target_day_reason: Most recent normal working weekday published on 2026-10-27 (October 2026 ZIP, last modified 2026-10-26T13:03Z, held 1-25 Oct; 24-25 Oct are a weekend and Mon 26 Oct was not yet published). Friday in Victorian school Term 4 (5 Oct - 18 Dec), not a public holiday.
calibrate_to: data/processed/counts.parquet rows whose bin_start falls on target_day

rules.coverage: only approaches whose every general-traffic lane has its own stop-line loop are written

aadt_sanity.note: Order-of-magnitude check only: SCATS day total on the approach edge vs the 2019 AADT of an AADT segment matched to the same edge. Different year (2019 vs 2026), a single day vs an annual average, and a stop-line approach vs a road segment; a ratio outside [0.2, 5.0] is flagged.
